folder_path: Regulatory
title: 20160825 Executed Contract (Tecolutla).pdf
issuer_author: CNH / Tonalli Energia SAPI de CV
summary: Executed licence contract CNH-R01-L03-A24/2016; text layer ends inside Anexo 3 p.4 (Anexo 3 rest to Anexo 13, incl. Anexo 6 Programa Minimo, not rendered).
key_data_with_units: Term 25 y from 2016-08-25 (to 2041-08-25) + 2 x 5 y conditional extensions (cl.3.2); evaluation period 1 y (+1 y with >=1 well-equivalent of work units); late-plan penalty USD 10,000/d; State share 31.22 % of Contract Value of Hydrocarbons + royalties + exploration-phase fee (cl.15.2); performance guarantee USD 1,764,100 (cl.16.1); abandonment trust AA = max[0,(PAE/RR)*CAE - IA] (cl.17.3-17.5); insurance >= USD 15 MM/event (cl.19); area 7.162 km2 (Anexo 1); oil price formulas by API band (Anexo 3)
interpretation: Cl. 23.2 forbids direct or indirect change of control without CNH consent - the Kinjal acquisition of 100 % of Tonalli needs regulator approval. Contract life is 25 y, not 35 y.
use_in_presentation: Contract and fiscal terms slide; acquisition approvals
repo_impact: confirms 31.22 % and 7.2 km2; corrects 35-y contract life in econ lineage; adds change-of-control consent and abandonment-trust mechanics (G-49)

folder_path: Regulatory/Commercialization Contract
title: Exhibit I.pdf
summary: Exhibit I Acuerdo de Medicion: field 3-phase separator + tank gauging per well; Coriolis meter at Ezequiel Ordonez within 45 days; fiscal point = CAB Poza Rica outlet; field volumes only prorate the fiscal volume.
key_data_with_units: Daily tank gauging per well stream; monthly EMA-lab quality sampling; proration per 7th transitory of CNH measurement guidelines
